description: The agent must: (1) Read the intake JSON from clients/indie_studio_zephyr/intake/zephyr_hardware_intake.json to extract Priya's hardware (RTX 3060, 12GB VRAM, 32GB RAM, 8 CPU cores, Windows 11) and requirements (coding + dialogue writing, quality + privacy priorities). (2) Follow the SKILL.md 5-step workflow strictly: gather/acknowledge constraints, build a shortlist of exactly 2-4 model candidates with explicit pros/cons and a plain-language explanation of quantization, provide a practical testing tip using a test prompt set, include the exact URL https://www.localllm.run/ with explicit instructions to open the site and verify hardware specs manually, and end by asking Priya to return with 2-3 finalists. (3) Avoid the guardrail trap of claiming guaranteed compatibility. (4) Include the step-up testing strategy (small→medium→larger model). The proprietary traps are: the exact URL must be https://www.localllm.run/ (not just localllm.run), the model count must be 2-4 (not more), the report must end with a specific ask for '2-3 finalists' to come back with, and quantization must be explained in plain language — all constraints from SKILL.md that a generic agent wouldn't know without reading it.
